title: The Interaction Algorithm and Practical Fourier Analysis: An Addendum
version: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society B 22(2), July 1960, pp. 372–375, doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1960.tb00384.x.

passages.note: The addendum clarifies the earlier statement about inversion of the Yates algorithm, gives a numerical example, and draws attention to a discrete Poisson summation analogue for relating yields and interactions.
passages.quote: a discrete analogue of Poisson's summation formula
